email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoInsulex patient with a pounding headache
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 58-year-old male patient with a history of type 1 diabetes received their second dose of DemoInsulex (dose: 5 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-08-27.
Approximately 1 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a pounding headache.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
T. Kim (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter451@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
